policy.initialization: identical historical R1 seed0 final checkpoint; tests retention under biased head fine-tuning, not learning from scratch
policy.frequency_rule: majority mass .9 or .98, remaining mass equally divided among other witnessed modes; uniform arm is uniform over modes
policy.effective_sample_units: 128 independent TRAIN layout families; generated perturbations are correlated teacher variants, not independent human demonstrations
policy.selection: fixed last1200; no generator checkpoint selection using DEV
policy.q: fixed historical R1 seed0 single q and calibration for all arms; no scoring improvement claim
policy.hypothesis_gate: biased empirical rare-mode recall@8 declines >=0.10 versus empirical uniform, with parent-bootstrap upper bound below zero; protection candidate validity decrease <0.02 for a claimed mechanism gain
policy.decision: If ordinary balancing or matching suffices, reject frequency balancing as novelty and diagnose another bottleneck. No method mechanism implemented before this gate.
